name: tts-cpp
description: Text-to-speech in pure C++/ggml: Resemble Chatterbox (Turbo + Multilingual), Supertonic, Fun-CosyVoice3, Parler-TTS (CPU + Metal / Vulkan / OpenCL GPU), and LavaSR speech enhancement. Sourced from tetherto/qvac-ext-lib-whisper.cpp (engines/tts). This pin enables LavaSR enhancer execution on ARM Mali Vulkan and pads small Valhall GEMM dimensions to preserve numerical correctness (PR #123), validated on Pixel 9a with CPU/GPU cosine similarity 1.0 and through the tts-ggml Device Farm suite. It carries the CosyVoice3 win32 model-load fix (PR #124), the ggml-speech 2026-08-04 floor, CosyVoice3 + Parler iOS memory reductions (PR #121), Parler Vulkan-on-Mali (PR #119), CosyVoice3 GPU support (PR #118), dl-safe backend initialization (PR #117), bounded Parler DAC decode (PR #114), Parler Vulkan (PR #110), Parler Metal (PR #103), and the original CosyVoice3 engine (PR #99).
